trials.brief: Build a browser zombie shooter with Three.js: WASD and mouse on desktop, touch on mobile, waves that grow and speed up, kills, wave, and health on screen, restart on R.
Build a browser game with Three.js where the player switches between 3 lanes to dodge obstacles that speed up over time, with a score, a game-over screen, and restart on R.
